a: An MVP is the smallest version that tests a core value hypothesis.
Story mapping organizes journeys into backlog slices.
A north-star metric tracks the core value users get.
Funnels track steps from awareness to conversion.
A/B tests compare variants to measure impact.
A roadmap communicates planned themes, not a fixed promise.
Collect feedback, prioritize, ship, measure, repeat.
Onboarding helps new users reach first value quickly.
Retention measures how many users return over time.
Scope creep is uncontrolled growth of requirements.
